title: Curated homepage three-layer migration specification
summary: This documentation iteration records the fully aligned three-layer target across eight product workstreams, the minimum seven-PR delivery plan, final frontend/source semantics, Aify Today Picks trusted-upstream passthrough, phased migration and production-derived acceptance gates without claiming product implementation. It preserves the current warm-paper frontend language while replacing source-group membership with a globally ranked 10–14/5–9/0–4 edition, and retains the landed occurrence system as current-runtime, raw-lineage and immutable legacy evidence.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "(ai daily requirements reconciliation|cross-agent iteration roadmap)" tests/unit.test.js

blockers.message: Harness Hub PR #106 is verified at c88d8a9717a8d5d515413f1a7de1849ba4de31f3, but the required migration rejects this dirty linked worktree. Rerun only in the clean standalone implementation target; do not transplant migration output.

lessons.lesson: Collection coverage, persistent signal quality and homepage editorial value require separate membership boundaries.
lessons.evidence: The 2026-07-15 public production artifacts contain useful source lineage alongside non-content endpoints, test rows, internal instruction copy and specialized records flattened into generic cards.
lessons.recommended_action: Use the accepted raw_observation to admitted_signal to edition_item sequence and do not switch routes before each phase exit gate passes.

lessons.lesson: A frontend replacement must carry a feature-survival matrix and real production fixtures, not only visual screenshots or example.com cards.
lessons.evidence: Existing E2E checks prove card count and links but do not assert summary semantics, X identity, GitHub ranking/trend or typed paper/model/benchmark content.
lessons.recommended_action: Preserve the current warm-paper topbar/rail/two-column language, build the 2026-07-15 production-regression fixture before PR3 / Phase 1A, and bind every replacement phase to PC acceptance IDs.

lessons.lesson: Publisher and collector are item-level roles, not a global credibility hierarchy.
lessons.evidence: Aify, newsletters and digests may publish a substantive article that is itself useful, or may only discover an external material; forcing every card to the underlying news URL would erase valid sources while conflating provenance.
lessons.recommended_action: Show the content publisher/author role and public collector lineage separately, linking each collector only when a safe stable URL exists.

lessons.lesson: A high-quality upstream edition must be integrated at its editorial projection boundary, not through a generic full-archive collector.
lessons.evidence: Aify's current generic search_api path consumes the full articles.json archive, drops native tags and appends community-lead warning text, while the homepage exposes a finished ordered ARTICLES_TODAY payload with usable titles, descriptions, links and taxonomy.
lessons.recommended_action: Use a dedicated fail-closed Today Picks adapter, preserve the upstream payload and provenance, invoke no secondary semantic processing, and keep edition capacity/dedupe constraints separate from content review.

lessons.lesson: A correct data lifecycle can still be an incomplete product plan when the original request spans frontend information architecture, visual design, feature recovery, source assets and operational acceptance.
lessons.evidence: The first summary reduced 11 user concerns to a data-heavy six-PR outline and omitted explicit owners for visual tokens, the five-layer capability-survival audit and historical source reconciliation.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep the eight-workstream coverage map, seven-PR atomic plan and deterministic contract assertions synchronized; phase count must never be used as a substitute for product scope or merge packaging.

followups.action: Implement PR3 / Phase 1A as source-asset reconciliation plus raw/funnel shadow in the real scheduled DAG, without changing active Aify configuration or old public generation.
Implement PR4 / Phase 1B as deterministic admission, clean pool, grounded summaries, publisher/collector identity and source-icon shadow while keeping the old publisher non-blocking.
Implement PR5 as edition and GitHub/X/Paper/Model/Benchmark shadow, including the dedicated Aify Today Picks passthrough and PC-016 evidence, without an active source flip.
Land reader UI, routes, typed components, active source configuration, legacy freeze and publisher switch as one atomic PR6 cutover; do not merge its Phase 3/4 checkpoints separately.
Before Phase 3, rerun Harness Hub migration in a clean standalone target and resolve .codex/.agents same-name frontend Skill authority.
